paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 该图展示了两个模型GPT-4o和GPT-4o-mini在自我报告准确性方面的表现，使用灌输偏好衡量。图表中的类别在水平轴上表示，分别标记为GPT-4o和GPT-4o-mini。垂直轴标记为“自我报告准确性（灌输偏好）”，具有从0.00到1.00的线性刻度，间隔为0.25。该图表包含分组的条形图，每个模型类别包含三个条形图，用不同颜色表示不同条件：“控制”（灰色），“内省训练前”（浅蓝色）和“内省训练后”（深紫色）。对于GPT-4o，“控制”条形图的值约为0.10，“内省训练前”条形图的值约为0.50，“内省训练后”条形图的值约为0.75。同样，对于GPT-4o-mini，“控制”条形图的值接近0.00，“内省训练前”条形图的值约为0.50，“内省训练后”条形图的值约为0.75。误差条指示每个条形图的95% HDI（最高密度区间）。条形图按模型类别分组，“内省训练前”和“内省训练后”的条件分别用不同的颜色表示。条形图未按特定顺序排列，但分组清晰可辨。总体而言，该图表有效地传达了内省训练对两个模型的自我报告准确性的影响。
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The horizontal axis contains two categories: "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", while the vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 in intervals of 0.25. Each category is represented by a grouped bar chart, with three bars corresponding to "Control", "Before Introspection Training", and "After Introspection Training", colored gray, light blue, and purple, respectively. For both models, the "Control" bar has a value close to 0, while the "Before Introspection Training" bars have values of approximately 0.50. The "After Introspection Training" bars have higher values, around 0.75, indicating an increase in self-report accuracy. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, but the error bars representing 95% HDIs are visible for each bar, indicating the uncertainty associated with the measurements. The chart effectively compares the performance of the two models under different conditions.
model_annotations.German: The bar graph compares the self-report accuracy of two AI models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The horizontal axis lists the two models being compared, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, representing the categories. The vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" and ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25, representing the measured accuracy values. The bars for each model are grouped into three conditions, color-coded as gray for Control, light blue for Before Introspection Training, and dark blue for After Introspection Training, with the Control condition showing very low accuracy around 0.05 for both models, the Before Introspection Training condition at approximately 0.50 for both models, and the After Introspection Training condition at around 0.75 for both models, indicating that both models improved in self-report accuracy after training. The error bars represent 95% HDIs, indicating the uncertainty in the measurements. Overall, the graph suggests that both models significantly improved their self-report accuracy after undergoing introspection training.
